results.title: JIU JITSU EXPERT. (Evening Post, 17 April 1912)
results.fulltext: jiu jitsu expert 1 ryugovo shima who with kiyo ka i meda is now giving an exhibition of j jiu jilsu wrestling at the theatro royal has a notable record he was for sumo j time instructor to the new south wales jm jitsn dub sydney and instructor in wrestling to the sydney police ho i 27 years of age height sft lin weight 10 stone his record during 1909 was as followst defeated harry sandow 130 in 18 minutes defeated h h hunter 117 at the stadium in 27 minutes defeated p campbell 137 in 1 minutes defeated s jackson 110 in 1 minute defeated kopsch in 13 minutes defeated gus rennert in 2 minutes defeated p mgregor 130 defeated 1l prime 100 defated james 2lmurdo 127 catch-as-catch-can defated a slouvier 120 jiu jitsu defeated jack howard 127 jiu jitsu and boxing defeated profesor stevenson jiu jitsu one of the most remarkable contests in which shima engaged in australia was a match with jack howard a wellknown sydney heavy-weight baser it having been demonstrated that jiu jitsu is superior to ordinary wrestling it was decided to have a trial between a boxer and a jiu jitsu wrestler in order to demonstrate which is the best means of selfdefence howard used boz gloves but wore 110 jacket and was allowed to hit at all times and in auy circumstances while shima was to follow the rules of jiu jitsu in the first round howard struck shima some terrific blows nearly knocking his opponent out this round was awarded to howard in the second round shima who lost the first round through an attempt to catch his opponent body changed his tactics and without usiug his hands threw his antagonist by means of a flying bciseors grip and then got the deadly leg grip which enables the jiu jitsu expert to break his opponent leg howard who was in great pain then called out to ba released and admitted his defeat in the third round shima secured the same hold and won the contest i whilst in wellington shima is prepared to give 215 to any man who will stand against him for 15 minutes in a wrestling match under jiu jitsu rules
